title: Create a poll
summary: Writes a poll for the open chat: a question, 2 to 20 options, one vote per person, and a choice to hide the results until the end. Sending puts the poll into the timeline.

roomId.description: The chat that gets the poll.

options.description: 2 to 20 options. Starts with 2 empty ones.

hideResults.description: true: PollKind undisclosed. false (default): disclosed, people see the votes as they come in.

canSend.description: true when the trimmed question is not empty and 2 options or more have text.

addOption.effect: Adds an empty option. Hidden at 20 options.

removeOption.effect: Takes the option out. Hidden at 2 options.

send.effect: Timeline.createPoll with the trimmed question, the options that have text (trimmed, in order), maxSelections 1 and the poll kind. On success closes the screen. On failure shows bipe_app_poll_send_error and keeps the text.

cancel.effect: Closes the screen. Nothing is sent.

notes: The composer opens this screen from its attach menu (composer spec, bipe-chat/bipe#563).
bipe_app_poll_option takes the option number from 1 as its placeholder label.
One vote per person in the MVP (maxSelections 1). Multiple choice and editing a sent poll are out of scope.
A poll is a plain Matrix poll event (m.poll.start, unstable prefix through the SDK), end-to-end encrypted like every message. No Bipe server code (parity polls).

In a quiet group a new poll notifies every member through the push rule chat.bipe.poll_start (chat-notifications, ADR 0026). Open polls the member has not answered show in the O que você perdeu block (bipe_group_missed_poll, groups.md).
DMs keep polls: ADR 0141 does not list polls among the features a DM does not have. If MZ decides otherwise, the composer hides the entry when RoomInfo.isDm is true.
